StorageHelpShareAddressWindows: Where this share is connected from, such as \\nas\Media. Missing shares are connected again from it.

StorageHelpVolumeName: Up to 11 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.

WireGuardConfirmRemoveConnection: Remove {0}? This server stops connecting to it.

WireGuardConnectEnabledHelp: Runs every enabled connection to another WireGuard host.
WireGuardConnectionLimitsHelp: Defaults for every connection. A connection can override them. 0 is no limit.
WireGuardDnsEnabledHelp: Lets peers reach Jellyfin by name. Their config files point DNS at the host.
WireGuardDnsNameHelp: Resolves to the host's own tunnel address.
WireGuardDnsUpstreamsHelp: DNS servers for every other name. Separate with commas.
WireGuardEmptyOff: WireGuard is off. Turn it on in Settings to add peers.

WireGuardEnabledHelp: Runs WireGuard with the downloaded wireguard-go. Turning it on downloads wireguard-go first.

WireGuardErrorLoad: Could not load WireGuard. Reload the page.
WireGuardErrorNoPeerConfig: Save the host with a tunnel subnet first.
WireGuardErrorNoTunnel: The tunnel is not running. Check the tunnel subnet and the server log.
WireGuardForwardsHelp: One per line, a local port then the remote host and port.
WireGuardHelpTool: Lets users reach Jellyfin over WireGuard with their own peers, and connects this server to other WireGuard hosts.
WireGuardHostEnabledHelp: Lets peers reach Jellyfin over one UDP port. Peers reach only Jellyfin, never the rest of the network.
WireGuardImportConfigHelp: Paste a WireGuard config to fill in the fields below.
WireGuardKeepaliveHelp: Keeps a peer's tunnel open through NAT. 0 leaves it out of peer configs.
WireGuardLabelForwardClientAddress: Pass the peer's address to Jellyfin
WireGuardListenPortHelp: The UDP port peers connect to. Forward it on your router.
WireGuardMemberDataLimitHelp: Limits all of a member's peers together. 0 is no limit.

WireGuardOurPublicKeyHelp: Give this to the remote host.
WireGuardOwnerHelp: Counts toward the owner's peers. The owner's groups decide whether the peer connects.
WireGuardPeerLimitsHelp: Defaults for every peer. A peer can override them. 0 is no limit.
WireGuardPeersByUserHelp: Lists each user's peers against what their groups give. Set the limits on groups.

WireGuardQrLabel: QR code of the peer configuration
WireGuardRestartHelp: Stops every tunnel and starts them again. Peers reconnect on their own.
WireGuardRoutedSubnetsHelp: Usually blank. Only for a router that does not NAT.
